about:
Prime Molding Technologies, Inc. was founded in 2002 in Riviera Beach, Florida, by a management team with more than 50 years of combined injection molding experience. The South Florida operation began with a customer-oriented and quality-oriented approach that has driven its growth.

The company runs a 24-hour, climate-controlled facility registered to ISO 9001:2015, housing 22 Nissei high-precision injection molding machines ranging from 20 to 500 tons. These machines, all equipped with robots and supported by auxiliary equipment such as central water recirculation, mold temperature controllers, and desiccant dryers, produce precision parts weighing from a few grams to over 2.5 pounds. Beyond molding, Prime Molding offers mold design and manufacturing, high-volume automated assembly, sonic welding, flow-wrapper packaging, part decoration, and fulfillment services. An on-site machine shop handles mold maintenance and repair, while tooling is sourced both domestically and offshore.

Customers span marine, automotive, electrical, medical, and pharmaceutical sectors. The company also accepts transferred-in problem tooling and provides just-in-time domestic delivery.

Prime Molding attributes its competitiveness to a lean corporate structure and state-of-the-art automation, which it says allows domestic pricing to rival offshore options while maintaining shorter lead times and shipping convenience. The stated goal is to meet or exceed customer expectations through quality, service, and low prices.
